title: Lucid
description: A local budgeting and data visualization app that turns raw personal finance data into an interactive dashboard. Built with a Python backend and SQL-backed storage for reliable, structured data handling.

title: Chat with my PDF
description: A local retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline for querying personal documents entirely offline. Combines a vector database with an LLM to answer natural-language questions grounded in your own PDFs.
